title: Prepare substrate TEC functions
action: Implement temperature‑dependent thermal expansion coefficient (TEC) functions for substrates MgO, Si, c‑Al₂O₃, a‑Al₂O₃, and LaAlO₃ using the parametric forms described in the model, and set constant TEC for SrTiO₃.
description: Prepare TEC functions required for thermal strain calculations.

title: Interpolate BST material parameters
action: For each BST layer composition (BST 60/40, 75/25, 90/10), determine thermodynamic parameters (T_C, C, b, c, Q12, s11, s12, lambda) by linear interpolation between bulk BaTiO3 and SrTiO3 values provided in the model, including the temperature‑dependent form for the b coefficient of BaTiO3.
description: Interpolate material parameters needed for each layer.

title: Compute thermal strain in each layer
action: For a given substrate and annealing temperature T_A, compute the integrated in‑plane thermal strain x_i for each layer at final temperature T_f = 25 °C using the integral over temperature of the TEC mismatch between substrate and layer.
description: Compute thermal strain that develops during cooling from processing temperature.

title: Renormalize Landau coefficients
action: Apply the mechanical boundary conditions (equal in‑plane stress, traction‑free out‑of‑plane) to obtain renormalized dielectric stiffness coefficients a_i' and b_i' for each layer using the thermal strain x_i, electrostrictive coefficient Q12, and elastic compliances s11, s12 as per the model.
description: Renormalize Landau coefficients due to thermal strain and electrostrictive coupling.

title: Solve equilibrium polarization equations
action: For a given temperature, applied electric field, and thermal strains, solve the coupled nonlinear equations of state derived from the total free energy to obtain equilibrium out‑of‑plane polarization P_i in each layer numerically using a suitable root‑finding method (e.g., scipy.optimize.fsolve).
description: Solve for equilibrium polarizations in all layers.

title: Compute dielectric response and tunability
action: For the following conditions: (a) a sweep of substrate TEC at annealing temperatures 550, 650, 750 °C at applied fields 0 and 400 kV/cm, (b) substrates Si, MgO, SrTiO3, LaAlO3 at annealing temperatures 450 and 750 °C at 0 and 400 kV/cm, (c) temperature dependence of the dielectric constant at 400 kV/cm on Si and STO substrates, compute the average polarization, the small‑signal average dielectric constant (from numerical derivative of average polarization with respect to field), and the dielectric tunability at 400 kV/cm. Write the results to /app/outputs/results.csv.
description: Main numerical results: average polarization, zero‑field dielectric constant, and dielectric tunability for the graded BST trilayer under various thermal conditions.
output_schema: Required columns: condition_type (string: 'TEC_sweep', 'substrate_annealing', 'temperature_dependence'), substrate_TEC (float, optional), substrate_name (string, optional), annealing_temperature_C (float), applied_field_kV_per_cm (float), quantity (string: 'avg_polarization_C_per_m2', 'dielectric_constant', 'tunability_percent'), value (float).
